body:
Spec: .adlc/specs/manifest-key-hermeticity.md, Layer 4. Closes the guard half of GitHub issue #398 (three documented instances of the ambient-state class: the tier-check clock race fixed in PR #399, the RAILS_BASE leak fixed in PR #399, and the ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY leak measured in #398's comment thread — 0/2 test segments passing with the key exported vs 2/2 without).

Build: a repo-shape lint test, scripts/test/env-hermeticity-guard.test.mjs, in the style of the existing shape guards (see scripts/test/roundtrip-coverage.test.mjs for the pattern of statically scanning test sources and failing on drift). Rule: any *.test.mjs under packages/*/test or scripts/test that spawns an ADLC entrypoint (execFileSync/spawnSync/exec of a path matching bin/adlc-*.mjs, scripts/rails-guard-ci.mjs, or packages/rails-guard/bin/) with `...process.env` in its env argument must, in the same env object or a shared helper it spreads, either (a) neutralize each of RAILS_BASE, BASE_REF, ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY (set to '' or a literal), or (b) carry a suppression comment naming the variable it deliberately inherits and why (grep-able marker, e.g. `// env-hermeticity: inherits ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY — <reason>`), consistent with how other hygiene gates handle deliberate exceptions. Declare-and-neutralize, NOT blanket scrub: the key is legitimately required by some spawning tests, which set their own literal. This guard is a backstop against NEW spawn sites — with the runner-scrub and library-boundary work landed it is not load-bearing for existing files, so it must pass against current HEAD without suppressions being added to files that already neutralize (packages/rails-guard/test/ci-bin.test.mjs and scripts/test/rails-guard-bootstrap-ci.test.mjs are the existing compliant examples). Wire it into the preflight test segment list if scripts/test/*.test.mjs is not already auto-discovered (check scripts/run-tests.mjs segment discovery first; if scripts/test is auto-included, no preflight change is needed and scripts/preflight.mjs stays untouched).

Acceptance criteria (spec AC4.1):
1. `node --test scripts/test/env-hermeticity-guard.test.mjs` fails against a planted fixture (write the fixture inside the test to a temp dir, or use an inline source-string case) that spawns an ADLC entrypoint with `...process.env` and no neutralization of RAILS_BASE/BASE_REF/ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY, with an error message naming the file, the variable, and both remediation options.
2. The same test passes against current HEAD.
3. Suppression requires a reason: a fixture with the marker but empty reason text still fails.
4. Full suite green: `node scripts/run-tests.mjs`.
title: Hygiene guard: test files spawning ADLC entrypoints must declare-and-neutralize ambient env (RAILS_BASE, BASE_REF, ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY)
